HELP_TEXT.TITLE: How to use the Slack Integration?
HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace. You can manage all your customer conversations right within the channel and never miss a message.

Here are the main features of the integration:

**Respond to conversations from within Slack:** To respond to a conversation in the ***{selectedChannelName}*** Slack channel, simply type out your message and send it as a thread. This will create a response back to the customer through Chatwoot. It's that simple!

 **Create private notes:** If you want to create private notes instead of replies, start your message with ***`note:`***. This ensures that your message is kept private and won't be visible to the customer.

**Associate an agent profile:** If the person who replied on Slack has an agent profile in Chatwoot under the same email, the replies will be associated with that agent profile automatically. This means you can easily track who said what and when. On the other hand, when the replier doesn't have an associated agent profile, the replies will appear from the bot profile to the customer.

SELECT_CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION:
Your Slack workspace is now linked with Chatwoot. However, the integration is currently inactive. To activate the integration and connect a channel to Chatwoot, please click the button below.

**Note:** If you are attempting to connect a private channel, add the Chatwoot app to the Slack channel before proceeding with this step.

DASHBOARD_APPS.TITLE: Dashboard Apps
DASHBOARD_APPS.SIDEBAR_TXT:
Dashboard Apps

Dashboard Apps allow organizations to embed an application inside the Chatwoot dashboard to provide the context for customer support agents. This feature allows you to create an application independently and embed that inside the dashboard to provide user information, their orders, or their previous payment history.

When you embed your application using the dashboard in Chatwoot, your application will get the context of the conversation and contact as a window event. Implement a listener for the message event on your page to receive the context.

To add a new dashboard app, click on the button 'Add a new dashboard app'.

PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.TITLE: Prospective Buyer
PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.DESCRIPTION: Handle customers who are showing interest in purchasing a license
PROSPECTIVE_BUYER.INSTRUCTION:
If someone is interested in purchasing a license, ask:

1. How many licenses are they willing to purchase?
2. Are they migrating from another platform?

Once these details are collected, do the following:
1. Add a private note with the collected information using [Add Private Note](tool://add_private_note)
2. Add label "sales" to the contact using [Add Label to Conversation](tool://add_label_to_conversation)
3. Reply saying "one of us will reach out soon", provide an estimated response timeline and [Handoff to Human](tool://handoff)
